answers.title: Private Azure resources from your laptop, with Bastion on demand
answers.question: Which way into a virtual network, Azure Bastion Developer with a jumpbox or Azure Bastion Standard on demand with native-client tunnels, lets a developer use private resources (private DNS, kubectl, azd deploy, private web apps and data services) securely, at the lowest cost and effort?
answers.time_box: 4 phases, stop and report after each
answers.author: Iheb Khemissi
